title: A CAP-like Trilemma for Large Language Models: Correctness, Non-bias, and Utility under Semantic Underdetermination
reasoning: The paper includes a specific section on normative decisions and discusses ethical dilemmas (such as profit vs. employee welfare) as core examples of semantic underdetermination. It evaluates how LLMs handle these choices through a theoretical trilemma framework rather than just as a standard ethics disclaimer.
